g.text: Figure 6a | Cross-area LFADS readouts reach compact training-selected ranks

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: The rank-38 archive ceiling is separated from the measured rank distributions so the 4–11 dimensional range remains readable.

Each point is selected by the one-standard-error rule inside an outer training fold; both directions and five complete-trial folds contribute ten estimates per pair. The rank-38 archive is a descriptive ceiling
because selected rank is bounded at or below it by construction. These are downstream within-session readouts from archived factors, not native LFADS generalization or anatomy.
